frameRate(speed);

var c = 0;

var p = 0;

var points;

background(255, 251, 245);

var draw = function() {

    if(c < curves.length) {

        points = curves[c];

        if(p < points.length - 4) {

            stroke(points[p][2]);

            strokeWeight(0.2);

            fill(0, 0, 0, 0);

            bezier(points[p][0], points[p][1],

                points[p + 1][0], points[p + 1][1],

                points[p + 2][0], points[p + 2][1],

                points[p + 3][0], points[p + 3][1]);

            p++;

        } else {

            p = 0;

            c++;

        }

    }

};

var mousePressed = function() {

    background(255, 251, 245);

    p = 0;

};
